items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the business corporation law and the limited liability company law, in relation to the incorporation of certain businesses for the purpose of practicing professional geology; and to amend chapter 475 of the laws of 2014 amending the education law, the business corporation law and other laws relating to providing for the licensing of the profession of geology, in relation to the effectiveness thereof
items.lawCode: Amd §1503, BC L; add §1105, Lim Lil L; amd §28, Chap 475 of 2014
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7552

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the business corporation law and the
limited liability company law, in relation to the incorporation of
certain businesses for the purpose of practicing professional geology;
and to amend chapter 475 of the laws of 2014 amending the education
law, the business corporation law and other laws relating to providing
for the licensing of the profession of geology, in relation to the
effectiveness thereof

 PURPOSE :

To allow business corporations consisting of geologists to become
professional service corporations or design professional service
corporations by amending their certificates of incorporation, to allow
limited liability companies to become professional service limited
liability companies by amending their articles of organization and to
correct technical errors in chapter 475 of the laws of 2014 to provide
for a 15 month grace period for geologists to be licensed by the State
Education Department and to form professional service corporations,
design professional service corporations or professional service
limited liability companies.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Amends § 15O3 of the Business Corporation Law, § l105 of the Limited
Liability Company Law, and section 28 of chapter 475 of the laws of
2014 to accomplish the foregoing .

 JUSTIFICATION :

Sections 1, 2 and 3 of this bill seek to facilitate the process by
which business corporations can become professional service
corporations and design professional service corporations section 4
seeks to facilitate the process by which limited liability companies
can become professional service limited liability companies by
amending their certificates of incorporation or articles of
organization. Without this legislation, it would be necessary for
these entities to dissolve their existing corporations or LLCs and
form new professional corporations or LLCs. These proceedings are
costly and time consuming and could possibly give rise to adverse tax
consequences. A failure to enact this reform could also result in
defaults of long term contracts that existing entities have with
governmental agencies and others.

Section 4 corrects a technical defect in Chapter 475 of the laws of
2014 that would cause lapses in business for geologists.
Specifically, § 7204 (b) and § 10 of the amended law require a
geologist to be licensed and to be operating as a professional service
corporation, design professional service corporation or professional
service limited liability company as of the effective date of the law
(November 21, 2016). It fails to take into consideration the fact that
it may take several months for geologists to accomplish these tasks
and that they would be unable to practice geology during this period
of time.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New Bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the State

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately; provided, however, that
sections one and two of this act shall take effect on the same date
and in the same manner as chapter 475 of the laws of 2014 takes
effect.
